web_launch.description: A one-time code that connects a browser to this gateway. `vis-agent web` puts it in the URL fragment.

web_launch_grant.description: What a redeemed launch code gives the browser: the gateway it reached and the token for its API.

oneOf.title: Cleared
oneOf.description: The user forgot the goal with /goal --clear. Clients show no goal, and the model does not see it. The record stays so that clients keep the highest revision.

iteration_budget.description: Maximum loop iterations for this goal; null means unlimited. Tokens are not a budget unit.

time_used_ms.description: Accumulated active wall-clock milliseconds through updated_at, including tools. While status is active, add max(0, now - updated_at) for the live duration. Inactive time is excluded; resume preserves this count and replacement resets it.

iterations_used.description: Completed model responses and their tools, including prose, empty responses and the response whose tools complete or block the goal. The final reply after that response is not counted. Provider retries within one request are not separate iterations.

session.description: Session metadata. goal is null until an explicit /goal or SDK request creates it. Other session fields are not yet constrained here.

agent_name.description: Coding-agent name resolved by the gateway from the session workspace configuration.

session_team.description: The subagents of a leader session. active counts the queued and running children; total counts all children. A subagent session has zero of each.

team_update.description: The payload of session.team_updated since protocol 21. team is the new summary of the leader. agents has the whole rows of the children that changed, in the row shape of subscription.ready agents. Since protocol 23, a step or Activity change of a child whose last pushed row the gateway knows that the clients have is in changes and not in agents. A lifecycle or request change, and the first change after 30 s without a whole row of that child, always comes as a whole row in agents. A client applies agents first: it replaces the row with the same session_id and appends a row with an unknown session_id at the end, which keeps spawn order. Then it applies each item of changes to the row with the same session_id. A repeated event gives the same rows.

changes.description: Since protocol 23: the changed keys of the rows of children that a client has. Each item has the session_id and each key that changed, with its new value. A key with a null value went away, so a client removes it from the row. A client ignores an item with an unknown session_id: it gets the whole row with the next subscription.ready frame.

team_change.description: The change of one team row since the last row that the gateway pushed for that child. Each key other than session_id has a value of the agent row shape, or null when the key went away. Null and a missing key mean the same: the gateway sends a key that becomes null or goes away once as null, and a key that is null or missing in both rows not at all. A client removes a key with a null value from the row. A lifecycle or request change never comes as a change: it comes as a whole row in agents.

session_group_color.description: Closed palette token a session group is painted with. Every channel maps a token to its own theme, so a group keeps its identity across the TUI, the companion app and the web UI. Never a hex string.

keybinding.description: One TUI key binding that an extension declares: the key after C-x runs a slash command, a built-in TUI verb or an extension function.

key.description: One printable ASCII character from ! to ~, the key after C-x.

command.description: A slash command line. The TUI runs it as if the person typed it and pressed Enter.

action.description: A built-in TUI verb id in kebab case, such as new-session. The verb moves to this key.

run.description: The key runs a function of the extension in the gateway. Run it with POST /v1/sessions/:sid/keybindings/run.

label.description: The hydra and palette label. Required with command and run.

group.description: The hydra heading. A command or run binding uses Extensions when it gives none.

extension.description: The name of the extension that declares the binding.

keybinding_run.description: The run binding that the person pressed: its extension, its declared group and its key.

keybinding_run_result.description: The result of one run binding. The function returns it, or the gateway reports its failure.

notification_event.description: A short notice that clients show as a toast. Extensions send it with vis.notify. A global notice goes live to every open session. A session notice waits in the gateway until a client opens its session, and then goes to that client once. A client keeps one toast for each notice_id: a later notice with the same id replaces it. The gateway never replays it.

notice_id.description: The toast identity. A later notice with the same id replaces the shown toast.

title.description: One short bold line above the text.

duration_ms.description: How long the toast shows on screen. Without it, the client chooses by level.

scope.description: global: every open session shows the toast. session: only session_id shows it.

keybinding_list.description: The TUI key bindings of the extensions of one session, in extension order, then declaration order.

upstream_status.description: HTTP status that the MCP authorization server answered at the failed step.

upstream_url.description: Authorization server URL that the failed step called.

input_tokens.description: Token count of the rejected per-question decision sequence, including state and question structure.

max_input_tokens.description: Configured encoder token limit for one decision question.

oneOf.description: Live only. A subagent of a leader changed: it started, took a step, opened or closed a request, ended or was cancelled. The payload has the team_update shape. child_id names the child that changed, when one did.

agents.description: Since protocol 22: the team rows of the session at the time of this frame. For a leader, each child that it started. For a subagent, each member of its team. Absent when the session has no team. A client replaces its team rows with these rows, then applies each session.team_updated after this frame.

decided_in.description: The closest wider scope that decides this inherited row. The row is read-only here.

is_set.description: Whether a secret row has a saved value. A secret row never carries the value itself.

suggestions.description: Values that an editor offers as completions. Other values can still be valid.

change_error.description: Present after a write when the owner's change hook failed. The value stays saved.

parent.description: Id of the setting that this row belongs under.

children.description: Settings that belong under this row, in display order. Children can have children.

editor_options.description: Static data for the editor. A presets row carries presets_options. A model row carries none: its choices are the chat models of GET /v1/models.

project_extensions.description: Project extensions of the context session. Only Machine settings show them.

session_snapshot_manifest.description: The manifest of a .vissnap session snapshot, readable without the engine.

attachment_reference.description: Keys that an iteration attachment descriptor adds when attach() keeps a reference to a file on the gateway machine instead of its bytes. attach() does this for a file that is larger than the attachment limit. The session database keeps no byte of the file. GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx streams the file from disk and answers Range requests. A client plays a recording or a clip from the content_url of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file?path=<path>, because a media element cannot send the gateway token. A client opens any other file from the content_url of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx/link, for example in a frame or as a download.

path.description: The absolute path of the file on the gateway machine.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes when attach() recorded it.

attachment_link.description: The answer of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx/link for an attachment that keeps a reference to a file on the gateway machine. A frame, a download link or another app cannot send the gateway token, so they open content_url. The route answers 409 attachment-not-reference for an attachment that has its bytes in the session database, 404 attachment-not-found for an unknown attachment and 404 attachment-file-missing when the file is gone.

content_url.description: The address of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx for this attachment, relative to the gateway origin. Its expires and ticket query parameters authorize the request without a bearer token. The ticket names this session, this iteration and this index only. The route streams the file from disk and answers Range requests. Its Content-Disposition is inline. Add download=1 to the query to get attachment, so that a browser saves the file under its name. A wrong ticket gets 401 invalid-ticket, and a ticket after expires_at gets 401 ticket-expired.

expires_at.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the ticket in content_url is refused. Ask the link route again for a new address.

preview_image_bytes.description: Bytes of one picture in a file preview. The picture goes as base64 inside JSON, which is 4/3 larger, and a phone decodes it. A larger picture gets a 413 answer.

file_preview.description: The answer of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file. The kind tells what the file holds and which keys come back.

oneOf.title: Text
oneOf.description: One window of clipped lines around the line that the client named.

line.description: The line that the client named, or 1.

first_line.description: The number of the first line in lines.

is_truncated.description: True when the byte cap stopped the read before the window ended.

oneOf.title: Image
oneOf.description: A picture that a browser draws, typed by its first bytes, not by its file name.

data.description: The bytes of the picture as standard base64.

oneOf.title: Binary
oneOf.description: Another file with a NUL byte. The gateway does not read it.

oneOf.title: Media
oneOf.description: A recording or a clip that a browser plays, typed by its first bytes. A player reads it from content_url, which streams the file and answers Range requests.

content_url.description: The address of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file/content for this file, relative to the gateway origin. Its signed ticket authorizes the request without a bearer token, because a media element cannot send one. The ticket names this session and this file only.

expires_at.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the ticket in content_url is refused. Read the preview again for a new address.

presets_options.description: The editor options of a presets row. A preset gives one value to each slot.

slots.description: The parts of each preset, in display order.

builtin.description: Presets that Vis includes. They cannot change. Their ids are also valid slot values.

is_previewable.description: Whether POST /v1/settings/:id/preview can preview one slot value.

presets_value.description: The value of a presets row: the active preset and the presets of the person. active is a built-in id or a custom name.

slots.description: Slot id to value. The owner of the setting decides what a value means.

model_value.description: The value of a model row: a provider and one of its chat models. An empty object names no model, and the description of the row tells what applies then.

setting_preview.description: Preview one slot value of a presets row before you save it.
